filters.purpose: Create a source checkpoint group for the original fractional coordinates and selective-dynamics flags.

Read exactly 1415 atom records from original CONTCAR lines 10-1424. This explicit whitespace-table schema preserves six columns and stops before the trailing zero-velocity block; it is not a general VASP reader.
Combine FractionalX, FractionalY, FractionalZ in that order. Preserve their values and source columns: normalization and removal are disabled.
Convert Direct fractional coordinates to Cartesian angstroms in Float64. Multiplication by 50 is valid only for this verified scale-1 diagonal 50 angstrom cell; it is not a general lattice transform.
Make the explicit Float32 coordinate copy required by VertexGeom. Retain CartesianAngstrom64 as the precision reference.
Copy all 1415 coordinates into the Ag1415 vertex geometry with Angstrom units (index 21) and AtomData rows. No crop, translation, duplication, padding, relaxation, or bond construction is performed.
Assign Int32 atom type 1 to all rows because the source header contains only Ag. This LAMMPS type is neither a grain ID nor a phase measurement; no Masses or potential are supplied.
Retain source atom-record identity as Int32 values 1 through 1415. Source line = SourceRow1Based + 9; exported LAMMPS atom ID follows the same row order. These are not bonds or feature IDs.

Export coordinate/type interchange: 1415 atoms, type 1, six decimal places, zero image flags, and coordinate-extrema box bounds. The original 50 angstrom vacuum cell and simulation settings are not exported. For read-only LAMMPS import use units metal, atom_style atomic and boundary s s s.

Save original fractional coordinates, selective flags, Float64 Cartesian coordinates, Float32 geometry, AtomType and source-row identity for inspection. This checkpoint records interchange, not a DFT or MD calculation.
